verdict.rationale: pnpm's docs say it switches to frozen-lockfile mode automatically in CI and fails the install if the lockfile is present but needs an update. Checksum verification can only be bypassed through an explicit --update-checksums opt-in, and monorepos share a single lockfile. Pinning the pnpm version (packageManager) and the Node.js runtime per project further reduces version drift across machines. Missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on lockfile semantics and the local frozen-install flag outside CI, and independent hands-on confirmation that resolved versions are identical across machines.
